verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a first-party agent skills plugin that lets users ask their coding agent, in natural language, to create Pods, deploy Serverless endpoints, transfer files, and deploy code with Flash (it also ships slash-command skills such as /runpod:migrate). It also ships two official MCP servers that connect AI tools and coding agents directly to Runpod resource management. Missing for 10: a native natural-language interface in Runpod's own console (operation depends on an external coding agent), any independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language operation works reliably, and detail on which operations the skills and MCP servers cover beyond the listed examples.
